response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in C++ (via National Instruments) and Rust alternatives (via Dlang), but his recent work has focused on TypeScript, Node.js, and other high-level languages, with limited exposure to modern C++ or geospatial routing systems. While his geospatial project (GISCollective) demonstrates relevant experience, his lack of direct routing pipeline or distributed systems work for large-scale systems raises concerns about immediate fit.
strengths: Proven expertise in C++ (National Instruments) and systems programming (Dlang), aligning with core tech stack requirements.
Experience with geospatial data processing (GISCollective, Green Map) and event-driven architectures.
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to expand expertise across technical stacks.
concerns: Limited recent experience with modern C++ or Rust in production environments, focusing more on TypeScript/Node.js.
No direct experience with routing data pipelines or navigation systems in a professional setting.
Risk of adapting to the full-stack requirements (Linux server apps, distributed systems) due to current tech stack mismatch.
